arStrings.szText:
When exploring the Pit, {c_important}Embers of Anguish{/c} can appear. Activating one drops {u}{b}{c_important}Progress Orbs{/c}{/b}{/u}, and causes {c_important}Andariel{/c} to ambush you at the end of the Pit.

Killing {c_important}Andariel{/c} in the Pit can now drop {c_unique}Unique{/c} Items from her {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u}.
